remarks: Welcome to 132 Madison Avenue in historic Bethlehem Park! This 3 bedroom, 1 bath home has good bones throughout and is ready for you to move right in - just bring your paint colors, not your contractor. The big-ticket items are already taken care of: the mechanicals are in great condition, and the sewer line was replaced in 2014, giving you peace of mind from day one. At this price point, it's a fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors looking for a solid property in a convenient location. And location is where this one really shines. Stroll to The Mulberry Italian Ristorante, a beloved local favorite. About 6 minutes away you'll find Tifft Nature Preserve and the revitalized Buffalo Harbor State Park, with its splash pad, accessible playground, bike park, and Lake Erie shoreline, plus quick access to the new Outer Harbor concert venue. Cyclists can hop on the Outer Harbor bike path nearby and ride to the Queen City Bike Ferry for a quick crossing to Canalside. Commuting is a breeze, too. With Route 5 and Furman Boulevard right there, downtown Buffalo is about 10 minutes away, and you've got easy access south to Hamburg and the Southtowns. Whether it's waterfront summers, Canalside events, or a quick trip into the city, everything Buffalo has to offer is right at your doorstep. Don't miss this one - join us at the open house on Saturday, 10/10 from 1-3pm. Sat 10/24 1-3pm
